text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A cabinet meeting chaired by President Ben Ali on Wednesday decided several measures aimed at boosting foreign investment.
- France will give Tunisia a 15 million dinar credit to modernise infrastructure in poor districts in Tunisian cities.
- New car ferry to be delivered soon to Compagnie Tunisienne de Navigation (CTN). The ship is to used on the route between Tunisia and Italy.
- Tunisia and the Islamic Development Bank signed an accord on technical cooperation.
